t: Proclaimed at Versailles in 1871 after victory over France, it united German states under Prussian leadership.
It became continental Europe's industrial giant and created the world's first national social insurance system.
After Bismarck's dismissal its diplomacy unravelled; defeat in the First World War ended it in revolution in 1918.
dyk: By 1913 German chemical firms such as BASF, Bayer and Hoechst supplied roughly 80 to 90 per cent of the world's synthetic dyes.
ev: Wilhelm I is proclaimed German Emperor in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles
Bismarck's Anti-Socialist Laws target the rising labour movement
Bismarck introduces national health insurance, the first of his social insurance laws
Wilhelm II dismisses Bismarck; the Reinsurance Treaty with Russia lapses
The first Naval Law launches Tirpitz's challenge to British sea power
The Schlieffen Plan fails at the Marne, locking Germany into a two-front war
Verdun and the Somme cost roughly 300,000 German dead without a breakthrough
The Kiel mutiny sparks revolution; Wilhelm II abdicates and the armistice follows
